answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 49490 Country: India Title: Sperm discharge Question: How do I make myself pure for namaz and everything else, after sperm discharge during sleep? Answer ID: 49490 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 27/29/N=01/1435) If you experienced seminal effusion while sleep due to some dream or without it and you found the semen on your body or clothes after you got up then you should perform fardh ghusl (i.e. gargling, rinsing nose with water and pouring water over whole body that not even space equal to one hair is left dry over the body). And if the impurity is smeared over the body then it should be specially removed from the body and then wear pure clothes or remove the impurity of unclean cloth and wear it after the impurity is removed. You may offer salah after you do so; nothing else is required from your side. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
